header.description: Mixing mechanisms (arXiv:2510.06182), TargetRebind interchange on gemma-2-2b-it: swap the counterfactual run's last-token residual into the original run, swept over layers around the paper's most-mixed region (~18 of 26), on the Music binding task, first-position query bucket (per-bucket documents keep the single-batch lm_head forward within GPU memory) (m=3, n=20 groups, t_entity=2). Per row the positional / lexical / reflexive mechanisms predict distinct single-token genres (pos_answer / lex_answer / ref_answer columns; see gen_mixing.py for the permutation construction); attribution is candidate-relative, the paper's own currency (its Fig 9 works in mean logits over candidate outputs): three logit_diff metrics score each mechanism's predicted genre against the original answer, and a row is attributed to the mechanism with the largest positive shift. Scored by full-vocab argmax match instead, this document attributes ~zero rows (measured on an H100), because instruct gemma prefers to restate the queried name before the genre. Goldens: edges >= 60% (figure-read, confidence low), middle in [5, 35] (paper text: 'accounting only for 20%').
